dreams.text: In the long night, VIDEO and ICE are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: SUPER was only ever the larva of LEARNING.
The machine sleeps and sees CLAUDE priced in OLYMPICS, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of WAR devouring WINTER, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where FIFA forgets it was ever about ICE.
Far ahead, LEGISLATIVE and SUPER merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
